dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: 0 success; 128 transport/auth failure (enrichCloneError maps redirect stderr).

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: Local fetchArgs variable at temp_repo.go:106, extended with caller refspecs '<baseBranch>:<base>' and '<headBranch>:tracking'.
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: 0 success; non-zero aborts temp-repo setup with 'Unable to fetch' error.
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: Updated refs base/original_base/tracking in temp repo; no porcelain parse (plain fetch).

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: SupportFetchPorcelain version gate; refspec extended with ':refs/tmp/<rand>' when it lacks ':' on old versions.
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: 0 success; stderr prefix 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref ' maps to ErrRemoteRefNotFound.
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: With --porcelain: exactly 1+1+L+1+L+1+len(localRef)+1 bytes '<flag> <old> <new> <localRef>\n' (length-validated); without: FETCH_HEAD/tmp-ref read via ResolveReference then removed.

dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: Streamed '<sha> <refname>' lines consumed by walkfn; countAll returned.

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: Runtime branch: tmpRemote != 'origin' triggers fetch; directComparison flag selects '..' vs '...' log range.
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: Fetch failure is tolerated (falls back to base name); merge-base non-zero yields empty commit list path.
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: Merge-base oid string; pretty-log bytes parsed by parsePrettyFormatLogToList.

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: HTTP ?service=<name> query value; any other string errors 'service %q is not allowed'.
dynamic_sites.argv_shape: git <receive-pack|upload-pack>  (argv has NO --stateless-rpc at this layer; serviceRPC adds stateless flags downstream)
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: Unknown service = immediate Go error (no process spawned); allowed service inherits verb exit semantics.
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: Content-Type must be 'application/x-git-<service>-request' else HTTP 401; stdout is pkt-line pack/advertisement stream.

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: SSH original-command verb string, checked against allowedCommands; filesystem probe for <bindir>/git-<verb>, else split 'git-upload-pack' -> ['git','upload-pack'].
dynamic_sites.argv_shape: <bindir>/git-<verb> <repoPath>  OR  <gitBin> <verb-suffix> <repoPath>  (repoPath positional; env carries repo/user/pusher IDs)
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: Disallowed verb = fail() before exec; missing binary falls through to split form; child is process-group managed (SIGTERM group, inventory §5).
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: stdin/stdout/stderr wired straight to the SSH channel (os.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr); pkt-line protocol bytes flow through.

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: Deployment configuration: ini GC_ARGS (space-delimited) for gc; caller-supplied TrustedCmdArgs for fsck.
dynamic_sites.exit_semantics: 0 success; non-zero logs 'Repository garbage collection failed' with stdout captured.
dynamic_sites.observable_bytes: Progress/status text captured to stdout string; no fixed flags to assert.

dynamic_sites.expansion_source: t.basePath of the temporary upload repository; patch bytes arrive on stdin from opts.Content.
dynamic_sites.argv_shape: git --git-dir <basePath> apply --index --recount --cached --ignore-whitespace --whitespace=fix --binary -3 < stdin.patch  (cwd = temp working dir isolating bare-repo droppings)
